llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: run.font.bold in python-pptx returns None for inherited bold (not explicitly set). If text inherits bold from a theme/master slide, it would be counted as not bold. This is acceptable since the instruction asks to 'make' text bold (explicit action), but could cause false negatives if some text was already bold through inheritance and the agent only set bold on non-bold text.
